# archestra_plugin (Resource)

Plugin package for a supported client. Choose authored `files` or a pinned `git_source`. Files are stored as opaque bytes without executing hooks. Changing Git tracking settings preserves the approved package; changing the approved commit or selection replaces it. Derived skills remain owned by the package.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_plugin" "example" {
  display_name        = "Operational helpers"
  client_type         = "claude-code"
  supported_platforms = ["posix"]
  enabled             = true
  files = {
    ".claude-plugin/plugin.json" = {
      content = jsonencode({ name = "operational-helpers", version = "1.0.0" })
    }
    "README.md" = {
      content = "Operational helper package."
    }
    "scripts/check.sh" = {
      content = "#!/bin/sh\nprintf 'ready\n'\n"
      mode    = "100755"
    }
  }
}

# Alternatively, declare a pinned Git source instead of files:
# git_source = {
#   repo       = "archestra-ai/terraform-provider-archestra"
#   commit_sha = "9e6a43f5347f6f3730ffeb75946f6e162791851d"
#   subdir     = "scripts/integration/fixtures/plugins/synthetic"
#   exclude    = []
# }
```

## Schema

### Required

- `client_type` (String) Immutable target client format.
- `display_name` (String) Plugin display name.
- `supported_platforms` (Set of String) Supported operating-system families.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Package description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the package is enabled; omission preserves the current setting.
- `files` (Attributes Map) Complete plugin file set keyed by safe relative path. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `git_source` (Attributes) Pinned Git content source. Configure this instead of files. Candidate synchronization never approves new executable bytes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--git_source))
- `icon` (String) Emoji or base64 image URL; omission clears the override.
- `labels` (Attributes Set) Credential labels; an empty set clears them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))
- `permissions` (Attributes Set) Additional direct sharing grants on this object. Applied atomically on creation and reconciled in place thereafter. Omit to preserve current grants; set [] to clear additional grants. The owner's existing grant is preserved automatically; inherited access and ownership remain managed by Archestra. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

- `approved_at` (String) Observed approved at.
- `approved_by` (String) Observed approved by.
- `approved_content_hash` (String) Observed approved content hash.
- `author_id` (String) Observed author id.
- `content_hash` (String) Observed content hash.
- `created_at` (String) Observed created at.
- `created_by` (String) createdBy metadata as JSON.
- `created_by_service_account_id` (String) Observed created by service account id.
- `deleted_at` (String) Observed deleted at.
- `file_digests` (Map of String) Observed per-file digests keyed by path.
- `id` (String) Plugin UUID.
- `last_sync_error` (String) Observed last sync error.
- `last_synced_at` (String) Observed last synced at.
- `organization_id` (String) Observed organization id.
- `pending_content_hash` (String) Observed pending content hash.
- `pending_detected_at` (String) Observed pending detected at.
- `pending_source_sha` (String) Observed pending source sha.
- `plugin_slug` (String) Observed plugin slug.
- `scope` (String) Observed scope.
- `source_id` (String) Observed source id.
- `source_kind` (String) Observed source kind.
- `source_marketplace_path` (String) Observed source marketplace path.
- `source_marketplace_plugin_name` (String) Observed source marketplace plugin name.
- `source_marketplace_repo` (String) Observed source marketplace repo.
- `source_origin` (String) Observed source origin.
- `source_ref` (String) Observed source ref.
- `teams` (String) teams metadata as JSON.
- `updated_at` (String) Observed updated at.
- `users` (String) users metadata as JSON.

<a id="nestedatt--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files`

Required:

- `content` (String) UTF-8 text or canonical base64 bytes.

Optional:

- `encoding` (String) Content encoding.
- `mode` (String) Git file mode, including executable 100755.


<a id="nestedatt--git_source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `git_source`

Required:

- `commit_sha` (String) Explicitly approved immutable commit; changing it replaces the package.
- `exclude` (List of String) Ordered exclusion patterns applied to approved source bytes; changes replace the package.
- `repo` (String) Canonical repository path on the selected Git host.

Optional:

- `github_app_id` (String) Existing stored Git credential reference; omission clears this authentication method.
- `github_pat_id` (String) Existing stored Git credential reference; omission clears this authentication method.
- `gitlab_token_id` (String) Existing stored Git credential reference; omission clears this authentication method.
- `provider` (String) Source Git provider, matching any selected stored credential.
- `subdir` (String) Canonical safe relative subtree, or empty for the repository root.
- `sync_interval` (String) Periodic candidate-check interval; omission disables scheduled checks.
- `tracking_ref` (String) Branch or tag tracked for candidate updates; omission tracks the default branch.

### Nested Schema for `labels`

Required:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Required:

- `actions` (Set of String) Actions granted to the principal.
- `subject_id` (String) Principal ID; use * for the organization principal.
- `subject_type` (String) Principal type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_plugin.example <uuid>
```
